About this home

Built in 1924, this single-story Spanish Colonial home is situated next to the historic 1885 Dane House and fronts the Landmark District's most coveted street in the Historic Highlands, a neighborhood defined by majestic oak-lined avenues and architecturally significant properties. This beautiful home reflects the enduring craftsmanship of the era with an arched entry, graceful Palladian windows, high ceilings, and hardwood floors throughout. Original vintage lighting, doors, and hardware have all been thoughtfully restored and preserved. At the heart of the home, a Batchelder tile fireplace of exceptional provenance features a rare triptych depicting the story of westward migration to California, an extraordinary piece of California design history. The thoughtful floor plan offers four spacious bedrooms, one currently used as a home office, and two bathrooms along with a dedicated laundry room. The living spaces are filled with natural light and the kitchen is both generous and bright, with French doors that open to a charming side patio. The primary bedroom features a wall of windows that open to a tranquil side garden, where a Spanish fountain creates a peaceful, intimate retreat. The expansive gardens are a living piece of California agricultural heritage, home to 100 year old orange and grapefruit trees, living remnants of the original Dane Family Ranch. The property offers ample space for a pool or ADU. The home has been thoughtfully updated with a new tankless water heater, an updated electrical panel, and a 220V EV charging outlet -- ready for the next century as confidently as it honors the last.

Key things to know

  • Spanish Colonial home with arched entry and Palladian windows on coveted Historic Highlands street.
  • Batchelder tile fireplace with rare triptych depicting westward migration in living room.
  • Primary bedroom features wall of windows opening to tranquil side garden and fountain.
  • Expansive gardens with 100-year-old citrus trees and potential for pool or ADU.
  • Two-car garage and five parking spaces on site.
  • Updated electrical panel, tankless water heater, and 220V EV charging.

Situated in the heart of the highly desirable Historic Highlands Landmark District, this wonderfully maintained Spanish Colonial Revival reflects the integrity of design for which the area is known. The property sits on a 14,648 square foot lot surrounded and shaded by mature Oak and Deodar trees. The beautifully decorated interior emanates warmth and comfort throughout. Great care and attention to detail have been given to the many traditional features including hardwood flooring throughout, high ceilings, crown moldings, period fixtures and lighting, and multi-paned windows. Dramatic formal dining room with large arched windows; a spacious, bright living room and a magnificent Bacheldor tile fireplace; a tastefully remodeled kitchen with beautiful tile work and a spacious breakfast area; a master retreat with a sitting room, a wood beamed ceiling, and a large cedar-lined walk-in closet; a remodeled full bath; and three additional spacious bedrooms.
